configurePresets.name: _hp2-base
configurePresets.description: Shared settings. FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR keeps pico-sdk, SFML and the rest in one repo-level cache reused across every build directory.

configurePresets.name: host
configurePresets.description: Native SFML build with tests. HP2_BOARD is unset so the root CMakeLists takes the host branch.

configurePresets.name: _rp2350-base
configurePresets.description: Common settings for the rp2350 boards. HP2_BOARD (set per board preset) flips the root CMakeLists into its rp2350 branch. Code runs from SRAM (PICO_COPY_TO_RAM): XIP execution is slow on the RP2350.

configurePresets.name: rp2350-adafruit-feather
configurePresets.description: Adafruit Feather RP2350 with PSRAM, 8 MB flash, 300 MHz.
